full_name: Maria T. Zuber | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Maria T. Zuber is the E. A. Griswold Professor of Geophysics and Planetary Sciences at MIT, where she studies the structure and evolution of Earth and the terrestrial planets.
